title: Command Tokens
description: The command-token panel, where a player assigns gained tokens or rearranges all their tokens across the tactic, fleet and strategy pools before confirming.

shots.heading: Redistribute: start
shots.caption: Status-phase rearrangement starts from the current 3 / 4 / 2 split of nine tokens; every pip is grey (already there), Remaining is 0, Reset is disabled because nothing changed, while Confirm arrangement is already enabled (keeping the current split is a legal arrangement).

shots.heading: Redistribute: moving tokens
shots.caption: Taking two tokens out of tactic and adding one to strategy: each pool shows its new count, removed pips are marked as moved out, the new pip as moved in, Remaining shows 1 and Confirm stays disabled with a prompt to assign one more.

shots.heading: Redistribute: not allowed
shots.caption: All nine tokens are placed (Remaining 0) but the fleet pool holds only 1, so the arrangement is not offered: the note says to keep at least 2 in fleet and Confirm is disabled.

shots.heading: Redistribute: ready
shots.caption: One token moved from tactic to strategy gives 2 / 4 / 3: Remaining is 0, there is no warning, the pips show one moved out and one moved in, and Confirm arrangement is enabled.

shots.heading: Gain: start
shots.caption: Gaining three command tokens: Tokens to assign 3, Remaining 3, the three pools at their current counts with reinforcements shown, and Confirm disabled.

shots.heading: Gain: partly assigned
shots.caption: Two tokens placed (tactic and strategy): their counts rise and new pips appear in the newly-assigned colour, Remaining drops to 1 and Confirm is still disabled with a note.

shots.heading: Gain: all assigned
shots.caption: All three tokens assigned: Remaining is 0, the note is gone and Confirm tokens is enabled; the whole gain goes out as one batch.

shots.heading: Leadership: purchase staged
shots.caption: Leadership primary with three free tokens and nine influence: two tokens are bought with the stepper (6 influence spent; Jord plus four trade goods, chosen like Auto-pay), so five tokens are to assign; two are placed and three remain, Confirm is disabled.

shots.heading: Leadership: ready to confirm
shots.caption: All five tokens (three free, two bought) are assigned: Remaining is 0 and Confirm tokens and purchase is enabled. One batch carries the pools, the two purchases and their payments, in the order the engine asks them.

shots.heading: Leadership: change payment
shots.caption: One token bought, then Change payment: Jord (2) and one trade good replace Auto-pay's Lodor. The editor lists each ready planet with its influence and the trade-good stepper, the account reads paid 3, owed 3, remainder 0, waste 0, and Use Auto-pay resets the choice.
